summary.text: Mike Chapman is a Washington state senator from Port Angeles. His official biography says he chairs the Senate Agriculture & Natural Resources Committee and serves on the Transportation and Health & Long-Term Care committees.

paragraphs.text: Chapman served for a decade as a local law enforcement officer and U.S. Customs Inspector and then served four terms as a Clallam County Commissioner, according to his official biography.

The page says he received a master's degree in Leadership and Liberal Studies from Duquesne University, a bachelor's in Organizational Management from Northwest College and an Associate of Arts and Sciences from Shoreline College.
The page lists him as Deputy Chair of the Capital Budget team on the Ways & Means Committee.
It says he lives in Port Angeles with his wife, Bobbi, and that they have two grown sons.
